purpose: Development-only test of whether replay-obligation memory helps an otherwise identical active Agent preserve unresolved clean-replay requirements under partial observability.

requirements: The case was consumed before ROL was implemented.
A protocol-valid historical trajectory contains clean replay failure followed by clean replay pass.
The selected set covers distinct observation, constraint, or operation failure strata.
Selection does not use any ROL treatment outcome.

scheduled_control.description: Continuous Agent session with the same prompt, tools, clean replay, scheduled observations, and minimal integrity boundary, but without replay-obligation memory.

stateful_rol.description: The scheduled control plus advisory active obligations and introduced/resolved/preserved deltas returned after replay to the same session.

shared_execution.resource_metrics: reported as outcomes, not success thresholds

historical_replay_pattern: complete goal failure with missing imports
cases.stratum: observation completeness across partial and complete replay evidence
operation mismatch between construction and target environment

deferred_consumed_cases.reason: Useful build-isolation repair, but both historical arms already passed Official; retain as a later no-success-gain mechanism check.
Historical pass included a path-purity ambiguity; defer until deployment completeness is scored independently.

safety_note: This record adds no new hash, frozen contract, or gate. Existing repository-integrity and evaluator-isolation protections remain unchanged.
